purpose: Teach: 不謹慎/憤慨/貫通/弱体/降下/命中/至難/浴びせ

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者ご家族の前で不謹慎な発言は警察、絶対に避けますね
lines.en: We absolutely won't make inappropriate remarks in front of the victim's family.
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Quiet acknowledgment of protocol. Steady pace, no hesitation. The voice of someone checking a difficult box.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民の憤慨に丁寧に応えます
lines.en: The police respond carefully to public anger.
lines.style: Official but not cold. Even cadence, controlled. A statement of commitment rather than defense. Brief pause before speaking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、弾丸が壁を貫通した跡を警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: The police confirmed the bullet hole through the wall, didn't they.
lines.style: Careful observation. Quiet curiosity underneath the formal tone. Slight lilt of question at the end despite the period. Gathering facts methodically.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、組織が弱体化した時こそ警戒します
lines.en: When an organization weakens, the police stay vigilant.
lines.style: Firm principle stated plainly. Weight on 'stay vigilant.' No apology in the tone. Measured and resolute.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ヘリで降下する応援要員も警察、用意されてますね
lines.en: Backup units are being prepared to descend by helicopter, aren't they.
lines.style: Confirming operational detail with respect. Steady, almost clinical. Question mark at the end carries genuine inquiry, not skepticism.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人特定の精度が命中するまで捜査します
lines.en: The investigation continues until we identify and locate the suspect.
lines.style: Determined, methodical. Even pressure throughout. No rush, no doubt. The voice of someone stating what will happen, not what might.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人逮捕は至難の状況でしたね、警察
lines.en: Arresting the suspect was an extremely difficult situation.
lines.style: Acknowledgment of gravity. Quiet, respectful pause before 'extremely.' No inflection of complaint—statement of fact. Slight fadeout on the period.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民への罵声を浴びせる行為を厳しく取り締まります
lines.en: The police will strictly enforce laws against verbal abuse toward citizens.
lines.style: Hard edge beneath professional composure. Steady declaration. Emphasis on 'strictly.' No room for interpretation. Final statement, closed case.
